title: Design System: Iqballaz Customs — V5 (Mansory Redesign)

display.purpose: Hero and section headlines only, short and declarative.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, cream on dark surfaces.

label.purpose: The single recurring eyebrow/spec-tag device — captions, kickers, nav sub-label.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill CTA, red fill sweeping to maroon on hover, no scale transform.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #E10600; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; isolation: isolate; transition: color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: #5C0F16; transform: translateY(101%); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Hairline outline button, fills to raised stage on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid #2B2320; color: #FFFFFF; font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; isolation: isolate; } .ds-btn-ghost::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; background: #171012; transform: translateY(101%); transition: transform 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-btn-ghost:hover::before { transform: translateY(0); }

components.name: Mono Label
components.description: The site's single recurring eyebrow/spec-tag device.
components.css: .ds-mono-label { font-family: 'JetBrains Mono', monospace; font-size: 0.7rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #8A8A8D; }

components.name: Centered-Logo Nav
components.description: Mansory-style nav: link cluster left, logo mark dead center, link cluster + CTA right.
components.html:
ServicesGallery
AboutGet a Quote
components.css: .ds-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr; align-items: center; background: transparent; padding: 20px clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 4rem); } .ds-nav-left { display: flex; gap: 24px; justify-self: start; } .ds-nav-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 24px; justify-self: end; } .ds-nav-logo { justify-self: center; } .ds-nav-logo img { height: 40px; width: auto; }

components.name: Splash Screen
components.description: Full-screen black splash with centered logo mark, fades in then out once per session.
components.css: .ds-splash { position: fixed; inset: 0; z-index: 100; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: #0B0B0B; } .ds-splash img { width: min(40vw, 220px); opacity: 0; animation: ds-splash-in 400ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1) forwards; }

narrative.northStar: The Atelier, Not the Tuner Shop
narrative.overview: Iqballaz Customs V5 replaces the black/graphite-and-single-red-accent system with a warmer, richer black-burgundy-maroon world modeled on Mansory's own site: a centered wordmark commanding the nav, generous black stage, and a restrained but deliberate red used the way a calliper or a stitch line is used — as one detail, never a wash. This is a redesign, not a new product: structure, motion engine, and type family carry forward from the incumbent system.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black stage with warm burgundy-tinted raised surfaces, never neutral gray-black.
Red stays the rarest color on the page; burgundy and maroon absorb the 'more color' mandate.
Cream and white are the only body/display text colors — no gray body text on dark surfaces.
Nav: links split left/right, real logo mark dead center.
A 2-3s black splash screen with the centered logo mark precedes first paint, once per session.

rules.name: The Red Rarity Rule
rules.body: Red's screen coverage does not grow in V5 — burgundy and maroon absorb the client's 'use more color' direction.

rules.name: The No-Gray-Body Rule
rules.body: Body text on any dark surface is cream, not ash and not a mid-gray.

rules.name: The One Eyebrow Rule
rules.body: The mono-label device is the site's single recurring kicker; do not introduce a second label style.

rules.name: The Hairline-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Separation comes from a warm-line hairline or a tonal shift, never box-shadow.

dos: Do use Deep Burgundy and Maroon as real surface/accent colors.
Do keep all body copy cream or white on dark surfaces.
Do center the real logo mark in the nav on desktop.
Do keep the mono-label eyebrow as the one recurring kicker device.
donts: Don't let red's screen coverage grow past the incumbent <4% ceiling.
Don't add drop shadows, glassmorphism, or glowing edges anywhere.
Don't invent commercial claims not confirmed in PRODUCT.md.
